extra.reason: Add $hh two-hex-digit escape support to Lexer's dollar-escape decoder

SuiteCaseRunner.BuildRegistry now catches DuplicatePouTypeException/DuplicateStructTypeException/DuplicateGvlNameException and reports each as a synthetic failing case (keyed by the conflicting type/STRUCT/GVL name) instead of letting discovery crash; other suites still resolve

Fixed: ArrayTypeInfo.Parse now accepts an optional resolveBound(text)->int delegate for non-literal bounds; Engine.BuildArrayDefault passes a resolver that evaluates the bound text via Evaluate(Parser.ParseExpression(text), new Frame(owningInstance, null)), reusing the existing GVL-resolution path (TcXunit-71o/_globals) instead of raw int.Parse. StructBoundaryBuilder's call site is unchanged (no Engine context available there) and still literal-only. Added 2 regression tests in GvlGlobalsTests.cs covering both the FB-field and struct-field array-bound cases from the reported repro. Full suite: 342/342 passing, 0 warnings.

Implemented ALIAS TcDUT parsing (DutAliasLoader) and TypeRegistry.ResolveAlias, wired into Engine.DefaultValue and StructBoundaryBuilder; added tests for alias-to-STRING(n), alias-to-scalar, alias-as-struct-field, alias-as-VAR.
